answer: A quill of collateral, staked under quadratic erosion, demands escalating slashing per marginal unit, so a Sybil cluster facing N nodes pays capital proportional to N², while extracted value scales linearly; this super-linear expenditure, anchored by sable liquidity sinks that penalize early exit, ensures marginal attack cost on any knoll of consensus exceeds potential rent by a factor of N, rendering profitable subversion economically null.
